title: Clarified 1691 onboarding set is a later miner candidate queue
summary: The `1691` dashboard learning count is not the old completed onboarding corpus. It is a separate zonoid learner candidate queue first committed on 2026-06-15 in `bench/onboard/zonoid/onboard-queue.json`, with `total:1691` and candidate sources 32 config + 622 doc + 272 git + 765 structure. It remained incomplete and advanced through cursor 50/70/110/130/150/190/210, then was rewritten in the main checkout on 2026-06-22. The dashboard reopens it because incomplete legacy queues are checked before/against durable completed onboarding state, so stale candidate queues can look like onboarding restarted even when graph `[ingest]` notes already exist.
